_comment: CANONICAL machine-readable form of the sonomos-vocab CONSTANTS, for consumers that cannot import the Rust crate (Desktop-Frontend TS, Locke-Extension / Depreciated-Desktop-Extension JS, Inspector). Mostly enums — one key per closed set of wire tags — plus, since v5, one key that is NOT an enum: infrastructure_reason_fragments is a list of PROSE SUBSTRINGS, matched with contains()/includes() against a peer's free-text reason, not a set of values anyone emits. It is here for the same reason the enums are (a non-Rust consumer classifies the same receipts and cannot import INFRASTRUCTURE_REASON_FRAGMENTS), and it is called out because the two kinds read alike and are not alike: an unknown enum tag is a decoder artifact, an unmatched fragment is just a reason that means something else. Every key is maintained by hand NEXT TO the Rust and pinned entry-for-entry, in order, by the crate's vocab_json_matches_the_enums test — no key here can drift from its Rust definition without failing CI. Vendored copies are synced by Locke scripts/sync-surfaces.sh and verified by its --check mode (Locke fleet pin vendored-vocab), same discipline as ai-surfaces.json: do NOT hand-edit a vendored copy. Values are wire/DB strings or match fragments, not display labels — presentation stays in each UI (separate detection from presentation).
